description: Extends the shared preset at yschimke/renovate-config. Automerge follows the preset (minor/patch/digest/pin; majors stay manual); `platformAutomerge` (the preset default) hands the merge to GitHub's native auto-merge, which waits for the `gradle` check the `Protect Main` ruleset requires (repo-policy/policy.json). Remote Compose (`androidx.compose.remote`) is an alpha line whose document format and APIs move per release: kept out of the BOM-aligned androidx-compose group and off automerge, so each bump is reviewed against the protocol's rcApiLevel and profiles.

packageRules.description: Remote Compose alphas change the document format and creation APIs; review every bump.

Stay on stable Compose Multiplatform: an app gets at least Livery's Compose, and one on the stable androidx BOM crashes (NoSuchMethodError) if Livery is compiled against a newer runtime. See gradle/libs.versions.toml.
